fields.Name: T108 - Knowledge Hub Configuration
fields.Description: Opens the Knowledge Hub Configuration screen once, then walks its inner settings sections (section nav + vector-setup stepper, thresholds edit with unsaved save bar, search-scopes master/detail manager), verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T265, T266, T267.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Knowledge Hub app (application switcher dropdown next to the logo) and click 'Configuration' in the left nav (fa-cogs icon). Then walk these inner settings sections IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each one set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) kh-config-nav — confirm the default section renders in the inner settings rail (Pipeline, Vector Database, Full-Text Indexes, Embedding Models, Thresholds, Search Scopes, etc.), then click 'Vector Database' and confirm it shows the 3-step setup progress (Providers / Embedding Model / Vector Indexes) with a completion count, then click another section (e.g. Pipeline) and confirm the inner content swaps while the outer header stays; (2) kh-thresholds-edit — open the 'Thresholds' section (range sliders: Duplicate Absolute Match, Duplicate Potential Match, Search Relevance, Autotag Confidence with live percentage labels), change one slider and confirm its percentage label updates AND an 'Unsaved changes' indicator plus a Save/Reset save bar appears, then click 'Reset' and confirm the unsaved-changes state clears (do NOT persist a save); (3) kh-search-scopes — open the 'Search Scopes' section (scope list on the left with a '+ New' button, detail area on the right), click an existing scope (or '+ New' for a draft) and confirm the detail area shows a tab strip (Definition / Providers / External Indexes / Entities / Storage / Permissions) with the Definition form (Name, Icon, Description, Status), then click across a couple of tabs and confirm the detail content changes (if no scopes exist, seeing the empty-state plus the New control is success). Keep going until every section has been exercised. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait for content rather than navigating away.

checkpoints.name: kh-config-nav
checkpoints.instruction: navigate config sections + vector setup stepper
visualCriteria: The Configuration screen loads with an inner settings rail that swaps inner content when a different section is clicked, and the Vector Database section shows the 3-step setup progress (Providers / Embedding Model / Vector Indexes) with a step completion count

checkpoints.name: kh-thresholds-edit
checkpoints.instruction: edit a threshold slider and reset the unsaved bar
visualCriteria: The Thresholds section renders sliders with live percentage labels; changing a slider updates its label and surfaces an 'Unsaved changes' badge with a Save/Reset bar, and clicking Reset clears the unsaved state

checkpoints.name: kh-search-scopes
visualCriteria: The Search Scopes section shows a scope list with a New control and a detail area; selecting (or creating) a scope reveals the Definition form plus a tab strip and switching tabs changes the detail content (a valid no-scopes empty state is acceptable)
